scientific_limitations: Sharpness is for the base-two radical-inverse, direct lexicographic three-flow decoder and particular real nilpotent 4-by-4 matrices. It does not characterize arbitrary low-discrepancy choices, older shuffle algorithms, nonlinear systems, or all matrix entries. The originating source was posted 2026-03-29; the decoder specifically used in this theorem appears in its 2026-10-19 revision.
